sn45.33:1.2: “Bhikkhus, those who have neglected the Noble Eightfold Path have neglected the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.
sn45.33:1.3: Those who have undertaken the Noble Eightfold Path have undertaken the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.
sn45.33:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Noble Eightfold Path?
sn45.33:1.5: It is: right view … right concentration.
sn45.33:1.6: Those who have neglected this Noble Eightfold Path …
sn45.33:1.7: Those who have undertaken this Noble Eightfold Path have undertaken the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.”
